title: Meta Expert Internal Campaign Plan
description: The structured plan the Meta Expert planner (Phase 1) produces from a user's stated goal, before any real Meta object is created. Asset fields are SEMANTIC references (e.g. "default_ad_account"), never raw Meta ids — the backend resolves those separately via the deterministic resolvers in server/tools/shared/. This file is the source of truth both a human reading it and server/agents/metaExpert/planSchema.js's validatePlan() agree on; validatePlan() enforces every rule below without an external JSON Schema library.

goal.description: The user's own stated business goal, in their words (e.g. "more website sales"). Not the Meta objective — that's derived from this.

objective.description: A real Meta campaign objective value. Must genuinely match `goal` — see validatePlan()'s goal/objective alignment check.

locations.description: Human-readable place names (e.g. "Karachi") for the customer-facing recommendation — display only, not used to build the real Meta targeting object directly.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. ["PK"]) — this IS what execute_campaign_plan uses to build the real Meta ad-set targeting (geo_locations.countries), via the existing country-level targeting mechanism. Phase 1 supports country-level Meta targeting only; city/region-level geo-search resolution (matching the finer city names in `locations`) is deferred, not built in this pass — see the Phase 1 completion report.

placements.description: MANUAL requires manual_placements to list which ones.

daily_budget.description: In the ad account's smallest currency unit. null when a budget policy/user input is still needed — see approval_required.

ref.description: "default_facebook_page", or a real numeric Page id already confirmed via meta.list_pages this conversation. Never invented.

instagram_identity.description: null when Instagram isn't connected — that's a valid, expected state, not an error.

ref.description: "default_ad_account", or a real act_... id already confirmed via meta.list_ad_accounts this conversation.

pixel.description: null when no Pixel exists or one isn't needed for this optimization_event.

catalog.description: null unless this is a catalog/dynamic-ad campaign.

campaign_status.description: Always PAUSED for a newly proposed plan — nothing in Phase 1 ever proposes a campaign that starts ACTIVE.

assumptions.description: Plain-language list of what was assumed/inferred rather than confirmed (Step 4's "infer when possible").

reasoning_summary.description: A short expert-style explanation of why this plan was chosen — shown to the user (Step 7).

approval_required.description: true whenever any field materially affecting spend/risk (budget, sensitive category, ambiguous asset choice, etc.) couldn't be safely inferred and needs explicit user input before execution.

open_questions.description: Only present when approval_required is true — the specific things the user still needs to decide/confirm (Step 4's "ask only when necessary").
